text:
Leah (Docs): Quick sync thread: I've drafted the deprecation notice for v1 endpoints and a redirects plan for old doc URLs. Need eyes on wording and the redirect config snippet. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4188

Omar (SDK): On wording, call out explicitly that v1 path `/v1/models` will stop returning model aliases on 2026-04-15. Also note SDKs will emit a soft-warning for one release before hard error.

Leah (Docs): Good — I added that. Did we decide if the SDK warning text should recommend the exact `codemod` command?

Omar (SDK): Yes. We'll ship a codemod in sdk-js v2.1.5. Example in the notice: `npx @redwood/sdk-codemod rename-model-param ./src` and link to the codemod repo.

Riley (PM): Timeline recap: announcement 2026-03-31, deprecation effective 2026-04-15, hard cut 2026-05-01. Legal wants a 30-day FAQ pinned to the announcement with escalation contacts.

Leah (Docs): Adding FAQ. Also need to handle orphaned doc links. Jun can you paste the redirect YAML we'll add to the docs site? I want to include a sample in the PR so support folks can follow.

Jun (Infra): Sample redirect mapping (will be merged to docs-config):
```
- from: /v1/quickstart
  to: /v2/getting-started
  status: 301
  note: "v1 quickstart replaced by v2 getting started guide"
- from: /v1/models/overview
  to: /v2/models/catalog
  status: 302
```

Leah (Docs): Nice. Can we add one for embedded snippet permalinks? Some customers bookmarked example output JSON which will change fields.

Jun (Infra): Added: ``- from: /v1/examples/embeddings.json -> /v2/examples/embeddings.json (301)`` — but note: permalinks will land on a migration notice page explaining schema changes.

Omar (SDK): For the SDK snippets: I've prepared two alternative examples (compat and explicit new param). Snippet IDs: sdk-rename-compat and sdk-rename-explicit. Will push them to the docs snippets repo.

Leah (Docs): Please paste the compat snippet here so I can copy it into the notice.

Omar (SDK): Compat snippet:
```js
// backwards-compatible call (will warn)
const res = await client.generate({ model: 'redwood-chat-1', input: 'hi' })
console.warn(res._meta.deprecation) // shows suggestion to use modelName
```

Leah (Docs): I'll show both examples (compat + migrated). Also adding a short note: "If you run into 400 invalid_param, see codemod and SDK upgrade steps."

Riley (PM): Ops/Support: Please add a canned response for support to paste when customers hit alias mismatch errors. Keep it short and include the codemod link.

Leah (Docs): Draft canned response added to PR under Support section. Text snippet: "We deprecated the v1 alias list. Upgrade to SDK v2.1.5 and run the codemod: npx @redwood/sdk-codemod rename-model-param ./src. Contact support@redwood.ai if you need help."

ci-bot: Preview deploy available: https://docs-preview.redwood.ai/deprecations/v1-apis/4188 — checks: 7 passed

Jun (Infra): One more infra note: redirects will be active the day of announcement to avoid broken search links. We'll route traffic to the notice page for two weeks, then start 301s after cutover.

Leah (Docs): Good. Final ask: someone from SDK team confirm the exact console warn text so we can quote it verbatim in the notice (helps customers grep logs).

Omar (SDK): Console warn text (final): "[redwood-sdk] DEPRECATION: 'model' param is deprecated. Use 'modelName'. See https://redwood.ai/docs/deprecations/v1-apis for migration steps."

Leah (Docs): Perfect. I'll merge once CI green and copy the codemod link + redirect YAML into the PR description. Thanks all!

Riley (PM): I'll schedule the announcement and Slack pin once PR merged.

ci-bot: Reminder: deprecation announcement scheduled for 3302340000 (2026-03-31).
